description: Lamto GIS layer (vector dataset): Road network of the Lamto reserve (Côte d'Ivoire) in 1988 is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by DataSuds. This dataset holds a vector layer for the road network in Lamto research station in 1988. To produce the dataset we digitized the roads from the map “Carte du recouvrement ligneux de la réserve de Lamto" published by Gautier in 1990. Some of the roads no longer exist in 2021. Coverage: Côte d'Ivoire. The portal files it under the publisher DataSuds. The repository dates the deposit 2022; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
